abstract: '''BEAST2'' (<https://www.beast2.org>) is a widely used Bayesian phylogenetic
  tool, that uses DNA/RNA/protein data and many model priors to create a posterior
  of jointly estimated phylogenies and parameters. ''mcbette'' allows to do a Bayesian
  model comparison over some site and clock models, using ''babette'' (<https://github.com/ropensci/babette/>).'
